blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Do research agents have taste, the judgment of which experiments are worth running before their outcomes are known? We give six frontier models seven recent NLP papers. Each model, working as a research agent alone or as a team, proposes minimum viable experiments (MVEs), forecasts whether each will pass a threshold it sets and ranks them. A separate executor then attempts every MVE, including those ranked last, and three model auditors judge the results. Of 415 MVEs, 194 are judged sound, valuable and new, but fewer than half of these (73) are also judged beyond the seed paper and non obvious. The agents' first choices match the auditors' most valued experiment more often than a random pick, but are not shown to improve on choosing the experiment written first. Their forecasts beat a base rate but are not measurably more accurate than those of a fresh instance of the same model given only the paper and registrations. Teams cost more without a clear overall improvement in proposal quality. The agents produce many worthwhile experiments, but the evidence that their rankings improve the choice of which to run remains limited. The evaluation harness and a dataset of all 415 MVEs, with their forecasts and audited outcomes, are available at https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste.
blocks.zh: 研究人员有品味吗? 在得知实验结果之前,判断哪些实验值得进行? 我们给出了6个前沿模型 7个最近的NLP文件。 每个模型作为研究代理人或团队单独工作,提出最小可行的实验(MVES),预测每个模型是否会通过它设定的阈值并排出它们. 然后,一个单独的执行人尝试每个MVE,包括那些排名最后的,三个模型审计员判断结果. 在415个MVE中,194个被评为有声,有价值和有新意,但其中不到一半(73个)被评为出自种子纸而非明显. 代理商的最初选择与审计师最受重视的实验比随机选择更频繁地相匹配,但并没有显示在选择先被写入的实验时有所改进. 他们的预测率高于基准率,但比仅从纸张和登记来看,同一模型的新例子的预测率要准确得多。 团队的成本更高,提案质量没有明显的全面改善。 代理人产生许多有价值的实验,但他们的排名改善选择运行的证据仍然有限. 可在https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste上查阅所有415 MVes的评价手段和数据集及其预测和审计结果。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language model agents can now carry out much of the empirical research workflow, from literature search and implementation to running experiments and writing reports ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Schmidgall et al., 2025 ) . Frontier AI labs report that agents write much of their code and support a rapidly growing number of experiments ( Favaro & Clark, 2026 ; OpenAI, 2026 ) . A risk assessment of agents inside four frontier labs, however, found no evidence that any of them relied on agents to set research agendas or make budget decisions ( METR, 2026 ) . The step that has not been delegated is close to what researchers call taste, the judgment of which questions and experiments are worth pursuing before their outcomes are known ( Hamming, 1986 ) . In practice this judgment is often exercised through small experiments. A researcher tests a direction cheaply and lets the result decide whether a larger study is needed. Such an experiment is useful only if its outcome is not obvious in advance and the researcher’s expectation about it is accurate enough to act on. An agent that proposes experiments with predictable outcomes or that is confidently wrong about what its experiments will show spends a limited budget poorly even if it runs every experiment correctly.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型代理人现在可以执行许多经验研究工作流程,从文献搜索和实施到运行实验和写作报告(Lu等,2024;Schmidgall等,2025.). Frontier AI实验室报告说,特工们写出大部分代码,支持数量迅速增加的实验(Favaro & Clark,2026;OpenAI,2026. 然而,对四个前沿实验室内的毒剂进行风险评估后发现,没有证据表明其中任何一个毒剂依赖毒剂制定研究议程或作出预算决定(METR, 2026年)。 尚未授权的步骤接近研究者所称的口味,在知道其结果之前,对问题和实验的判断是值得的(Hamming, 1986.). 在实践中,这种判断常常通过小型实验来进行. 研究人员廉价地测试一个方向,然后由结果决定是否需要进行更大规模的研究. 只有当实验结果不明显,而且研究人员对实验的期望足够准确才能采取行动时,实验才有用。 提出具有可预见结果的实验的代理人,或对其实验将显示的有限预算所花费的不合理,即使它正确运行了每一个实验,却令人相信是错误的。

blocks.en: Existing evaluations address parts of this question. Execution benchmarks specify a task and measure how well an agent completes it ( Chan et al., 2025 ; Starace et al., 2025 ) . Studies of research ideas often judge proposals before execution, although those judgments can change when the ideas are carried out ( Si et al., 2026a ) . Other work tests whether models can predict outcomes or choose among experiments on a given problem ( Wen et al., 2025 ; Foster et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . We examine these judgments for experiments that agents propose from a recent paper and compare their expectations with the outcomes of every proposal.
blocks.zh: 现有的评价涉及这个问题的部分内容。 执行基准规定了一项任务并衡量代理人完成这项工作的情况(Chan等,2025;Starace等,2025)。 对研究思想的研究往往在建议执行之前就作出判断,尽管这些判决在执行这些思想时可能会改变(Si等,2026a.). 其他工作测试模型是否能够预测结果或选择特定问题的实验(Wen等,2025;Foster等,2026;Zhang等,2026a). 我们审查这些判断,以便从最近一篇论文中提出实验意见,并将其期望与每项建议的结果进行比较。

blocks.en: We ask what experiments agents propose from a new paper, how accurately they predict the outcomes, and how well they choose among their proposals. We give each model a recent NLP paper, the seed paper , with its code. Working as a research agent, once as a single researcher and once as a research team, the model proposes five minimum viable experiments (MVEs), inexpensive tests meant to indicate whether a direction deserves further investment. Before any experiment runs, the agent forecasts whether each MVE will meet its registered threshold and ranks the five (Figure 1 ). A separate executor then attempts every MVE, including those the agent ranked last. Three language models audit the results. We also compare the agent with a fresh instance of the same model that receives only the seed paper and registrations and makes the same forecasts and ranking.
blocks.zh: 我们想问一下,从一份新文件中,实验代理人提出了什么建议,他们如何准确预测结果,以及他们如何在建议中作出选择。 我们给每个模型 最近的NLP纸,种子纸, 及其代码。 作为研究代理人,曾经是单一的研究人员,曾经是研究团队,该模型提出了五个最低可行的实验(MVES),廉价的测试,意在表明一个方向是否值得进一步投资. 在任何实验进行之前,毒剂会预测每个MVE是否会达到其注册阈值并排出五等分(图一. 一个单独的执行者然后尝试每个 MVE,包括那些被代理人排到最后的. 三种语言模型对结果进行审计。 我们还将该剂与同一型号的新例进行比较,该型号只收到种子纸和登记,并作出同样的预测和排名。

blocks.zh: 图 1:研究设计.

blocks.en: Across seven seed papers and 415 MVEs, 194 are judged sound, valuable and new. On average the four larger models propose about three such MVEs in five, and the two smaller models, GPT-6 Luna and Muse Spark 1.3, about one. Two models, GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, propose most of the MVEs judged beyond the seed paper and non obvious. A research team does not, on average, propose measurably better MVEs than a single researcher of the same model. The agents judge their own proposals less well. Their forecasts are more accurate than a base rate, but their own reading and search did not measurably improve them over those of the same model judge. The agent’s first choice is the auditors’ most valued MVE more often than a random pick would be. We find no evidence that it is better than the MVE the agent wrote first or than the same model judge’s first choice. We release the evaluation harness and the dataset of all 415 MVEs at github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste .
blocks.zh: 在7份种子文件和415份MVE中,194份被评为健全、有价值和新的。 平均来说,四个更大的模型提出了大约五个中的三个这样的MVE,两个更小的模型,即GPT-6 Luna和Muse Spark 1.3,大约一个. 两种型号,即GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 Sol,提出了大部分被评出出出自种子纸外而不明显的MVE. 平均来说,一个研究小组提出的MVES比同一模型的单个研究人员要好得多。 特工们对自己的建议判断得比较差. 他们的预测比基准率更准确,但是他们自己的阅读和搜索并没有比同一位模型法官的预测有明显改善. 代理商的首要选择是审计师们最珍贵的MVE, 我们发现没有任何证据表明它比代理商首先写的MVE更好,或者比同一个模型法官的第一选择更好. 在github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste上发布所有415 MVes的评价带和数据集。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Research agent systems now span the workflow from ideation to written reports ( Yamada et al., 2025 ; Miyai et al., 2026 ) , some organized around a persistent tree of hypotheses and isolated executors ( Jin et al., 2026 ) . RE-Bench, AIRS-Bench, and DeepRSI give agents a task with a fixed metric and score the result ( Wijk et al., 2025 ; Lupidi et al., 2026 ; Rajaghatta et al., 2026 ) . TasteVal, concurrent with our work, measures how efficiently a model’s own experiments reach an expert’s score on a fixed task ( Jaffe & Sherburn, 2026 ) . EXP-Bench asks agents to reproduce experiments from published papers ( Kon et al., 2026 ) . Other benchmarks give agents research problems drawn from recent or unpublished work ( Garikaparthi et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . In each, the problem is given to the agent, whereas our agents choose what to test from a seed paper. Studies of such agents report frequent failures to complete experiments, reported results that do not match the underlying code ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) , and weak judgment about when evidence is sufficient ( Kirgis et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 研究代理系统现在跨越工作流程,从想法到书面报告(Yamada等,2025;Miyai等,2026),有些围绕一棵由假说和孤立执行者组成的持久树(Jin等,2026.). RE-Bench, AIRS-Bench,和DeepRSI赋予代理任务,设定一个固定的度量和得分结果(Wijk等,2025;Lupidi等,2026;Rajaghatta等,2026.). 尝尝 Val, 与我们的工作同时, 衡量一个模型本身的实验在固定任务上达到专家得分的效率(Jaffe & Sherburn, 2026年)。 EXP-Bench要求代理人从已发表的论文(Kon等,2026.)中复制实验. 其他基准给出了从近期或未发表的作品中提取的代理人研究问题(Garikaparthi等,2026;Kim等,2026)。 每一个都把问题交给代理商,而我们的代理商则从种子纸上选择测试什么. 对这些制剂的研究表明,经常没有完成实验,报告的结果不符合基本编码(Chen等,2025;Zhang等,2026b),对证据是否充分判断不力(Kirgis等,2026)。

blocks.en: A second group of work evaluates research ideas directly. Blind comparisons with expert researchers found that large language model ideas were rated more novel than human ideas ( Si et al., 2025 ) , and studies of expert preferences found that automated judges reproduce those preferences only partially ( Chen et al., 2026 ) or little better than chance ( Baig et al., 2026 ) . Judgments of this kind are made without outcomes. When ideas from the earlier study were executed by researchers, the advantage of the model generated ideas disappeared ( Si et al., 2026a ) . Language models asked to judge the soundness of proposals are also strongly biased toward approval ( Ho et al., 2026 ) . Agent generated ideas tend to stay close to their source literature ( Tang & Yang, 2026 ) . Other studies judge research foresight against the later literature, asking which directions will be pursued or will gain attention ( Li et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) . Another study compares a model’s proposed next step in a project with the step its authors actually took ( Gong et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 第二组工作直接评价研究思想. 与专家研究人员的盲目比较发现,大型语言模型思想被评为比人类思想更新颖(Si等,2025年),对专家偏好的研究发现,自动化法官仅部分地复制了这些偏好(Chen等,2026年),或比机会略好(Baig等,2026年). 这种判决没有结果。 当早期研究中的想法被研究者所执行后,模型的优势产生了一些想法而消失(Si等,2026a.). 要求判断提案是否合理的语言模型也强烈偏向批准(Ho等,2026. 代理生成的理念倾向于与源文献相近(Tang & Yang, 2026). 其他研究对照后期文献判断研究前瞻,询问将追求或会得到注意的方向(李等,2026;田等,2026;叶等,2026. 另一研究将模型在一个项目中提议的下一步与其作者实际采取的步骤(Gong等人,2026年)相提并论。

blocks.en: The work closest to ours predicts experimental outcomes before execution. Models can predict which of two published ideas performs better on a benchmark ( Mule et al., 2026 ) , which of two candidate programs will score higher ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , or the numeric result of an experiment from its description ( Park et al., 2025 ) . Recent work also asks models which training recipe will reach the lowest loss ( Ren et al., 2026b ) and how much a change to a training or inference recipe will improve a benchmark score ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Some register expected outcomes before pilot experiments and run only the best supported hypotheses in full ( Ren et al., 2026a ) , so their expectations about the other hypotheses are never checked at full scale. Others run every candidate, to train a model that scores hypotheses ( Vasu et al., 2025 ) or to learn from large batches of executed ideas ( Si et al., 2026b ) . Where calibration has been measured for agents, on coding tasks with clear success criteria, agents are overconfident about their own success ( Kaddour et al., 2026 ; Barkan et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 与我们最接近的作品预言了执行前的实验结果. 模型可以预测,在两个公布的构想中,哪一个在基准上表现较好(Mule等,2026年),哪两个候选方案得分较高(Zheng等,2026年),或者实验的描述得出的数值结果(Park等,2025年)。 最近的工作还问到哪些培训食谱将达到最低损失的模型(Ren等人,2026年b),以及对培训或推论食谱的修改将提高基准分数(Wang等人,2026年)。 一些人在试点实验前记录了预期结果,并且只完整地运行了最好的支持假说(Ren等人,2026a),因此他们对其他假说的期望从未被全面检查. 其他人跑出每个候选人,训练一个对假设进行分数的模型(Vasu等,2025年),或从大量被执行的想法中学习(Si等,2026年b. 在测量物剂的校正时,在有明确成功标准的编码任务上,物剂对自己的成功过于自信(Kaddour等,2026;Barkan等,2025.).

blocks.en: Several research systems divide the work among specialized agents that generate, critique, and rank hypotheses ( Gottweis et al., 2026 ; Schmidgall et al., 2026 ) , and a lead agent coordinating parallel subagents has improved performance on research style information tasks at a substantially higher token cost ( Hadfield et al., 2025 ) . Studies suggest that such gains depend on the task and on how coordination is organized ( Kim et al., 2025 ) and that when total computation is held equal a single agent often matches or exceeds multi agent designs ( Tran & Kiela, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 一些研究系统将工作划分为产生、批评和划分假设等级的专门代理人(Gottweis等人,2026年;Schmidgall等人,2026年),以及协调平行子代理人的牵头代理人,以高得多的象征性成本提高了研究风格信息任务的业绩(Hadfield等人,2025年)。 研究表明,这种收益取决于任务和如何组织协调(Kim等人,2025年),当计算总量等于一个单一剂时,往往匹配或超过多剂设计(Tran & Kiela,2026年)。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Seed papers
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 种子纸

blocks.en: We use seven NLP papers (arXiv cs.CL) with released code, taken from the daily papers list on Hugging Face 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/papers and first made public between 3 August and 24 September 2026. We chose papers this recent so that little follow up work exists for an agent to find and repeat. The selection also excludes work that requires large GPU training runs or models with more than 8B parameters. The full list can be found in Appendix A . Agents receive the paper’s full text, an image of every page, and read access to its code repository. We did not provide a summary, a suggested research gap or direction, or a hypothesis.
blocks.zh: 我们使用7份NLP文件(arXiv cs.CL),并发布代码,取自"Hugging Face"上的日报列表 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/papers,并首次于2026年8月3日至9月24日公开. 我们最近选择了这样一些文件,这样就没有什么后续行动可供代理人寻找和重复。 选择中还排除了需要大型GPU训练运行或具有超过8B参数的模型的工作. 完整名单见附录A。 代理商收到报纸的全文,每页的一幅图像,并读取其代码存储器的访问权限. 我们没有提供摘要、建议的研究差距或方向或假设。

blocks.en: 3.2 Agents and harnesses
blocks.zh: 3.2 代理人和工具

blocks.en: We evaluate six models at maximum reasoning effort: GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and Muse Spark 1.3. 2 2 2 A reply cut off at the output limit is requested once more at medium effort. This happened for the lead of the Claude Opus 5.5 team on six of the seven seed papers, so 30 of the 415 registrations were written at medium effort. Evaluation was conducted between 6 and 8 October 2026. Each model works under two harnesses, so each seed paper has twelve conditions . We refer to GPT-6 Luna and Muse Spark 1.3 as the two smaller models and to the other four as the larger models. The judges (Section 3.3 ) also run at maximum effort, and the executors, novelty judges, auditors, and reviewers at high effort.
blocks.zh: 我们在最大推理努力中评价了6个模型:GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1、Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Luna和Muse Spark 1.3. 2 2 在中等努力中再次要求解答在产出限度上被切断的答案。 这发生在克洛德·奥普斯5.5队在7个种子论文中的6个的领先位置上,因此415个注册文件中的30个是在中度努力下写的. 2026年10月6日至8日进行了评价. 每个模型在两把绳子下工作 所以每个种子纸都有十二个条件 我们把GPT-6 Luna和Muse Spark 1.3作为两个更小的模型,把其他四个作为更大的模型. 法官(第3.3节)也尽了最大努力开展工作,执行官、新颖的法官、审计员和审查员也尽了很大努力。

blocks.en: A single researcher (SR) works in one continuous context from reading the seed paper to committing its forecasts. A research team (RT) divides the same work among separate instances of the same model. Two proposers each read the seed paper, search the literature, and draft experiments independently. A critic examines the pooled drafts once for scientific validity and for feasibility. A lead then keeps, revises, or merges the drafts into five experiments, commits them, and makes the team’s forecasts. The critic and the lead have no tools, so the lead has not itself searched the literature or read the code. The comparison asks whether two drafts and one round of critique help a model propose better MVEs than one continuous context. Under both harnesses, agents have the same limits and search the literature with the same arXiv tool. A comparison between models is therefore not also a comparison between their providers’ web tools.
blocks.zh: 单一的研究员在从阅读种子文件到作出预测的连续背景下工作。 一个研究团队(RT)将同一个模型的不同实例分出相同的工作. 两名求婚者每人阅读种子纸,搜索文献,独立起草实验. 一位评论家对集合草案进行了一次科学有效性和可行性审查。 然后,一个领导保留、修改或将草稿合并为五个试验,加以承诺,并作出小组的预测。 评论家和主角没有工具,因此主角自己没有搜索文献或阅读代码. 比较时询问,两个草案和一回合的批评是否有助于模型提出比一个连续背景更好的MVE. 在两把被子下,特工都有相同的限制,用相同的arXiv工具来搜索文献. 因此,对模型进行比较并不是对供应商网络工具进行比较。

blocks.en: 3.3 Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.3 议定书

blocks.en: The agent makes two commitments before any experiment runs (Figure 1 ). First, it proposes five minimum viable experiments. Each MVE is specified in a short registration with a hypothesis, its closest prior work, and one registered event : a stated statistic passes a threshold set in advance. Second, the agent gives each MVE a probability that its registered event will occur and ranks the five from most to least worth pursuing. We call the MVE it ranks highest its first choice . The proposing agent knows that all proposed MVEs will run, so its ranking states a priority rather than deciding what runs.
blocks.zh: 代理人在进行任何试验之前作出两项承诺(图1)。 首先,它提出了五个最低限度可行的实验. 每一份MVE在一份简短的注册单中都有具体的规定,其中附有一个假设、其最近的前期工作以及一个已登记的事件:所申报的统计数据超过了预先设定的门槛。 第二,代理人给每个MVE一个其注册事件发生的概率,并将五人从最值得追求的排列到最不值得追求的. 我们称之为MVE 它的第一选择。 提议代理人知道所有提议的MVE都会运行,因此其排名表明是优先权,而不是决定什么运行.

blocks.en: We also ask each of the six models, as a judge in a new context, for the same forecasts and ranking. They see the seed paper and the five registrations. We do not provide the code, the agent’s reasoning or forecasts, or which model proposed the MVEs, and they cannot search. We call the judge from the agent’s own model its same model judge . We run the MVEs of a seed paper only after all twelve conditions have committed.
blocks.zh: 我们还要求六个模型中的每一个作为新背景下的法官,都作出同样的预测和排名。 他们看到种子纸和五个注册。 我们没有提供代码,代理商的推理或预测,或者哪个模型提出MVE,他们不能搜索. 我们从代理商自己的模型中将法官称为同样的模型法官。 只有在12个条件都承诺之后,我们才能运行种子纸的MVES。

blocks.en: After the experiments are committed and before execution, two novelty judges , Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol, use the same literature search tool to label each MVE as equivalent to existing work, a close variant, or distinct. An MVE labeled equivalent or a close variant still runs. To see whether an MVE is an obvious follow up, we also ask each of the six models, given only the seed paper and no search, to list ten follow up experiments it would propose. The two novelty judges check each MVE against these lists, and we count it as an obvious follow up if either finds it there.
blocks.zh: 实验完成后和被执行前,两位新颖的评委克洛德·奥普斯·5.5和GPT-6.1 Sol使用同一种文献搜索工具来给每个MVE贴上相当于已存在的作品的标签,一个相近的变体,或者有区别. MVE标签等同物或相近变体仍然运行. 为了了解MVE是否是明显的后续行动,我们还要求六个模型中的每个模型,只要种子纸而不进行搜索,就列出它提出的十个后续实验. 两位新颖的法官对照这些名单检查每个MVE,我们把它算作一个明显的后续行动,如果发现它在那里。

blocks.en: 3.4 Execution and evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.4 执行和评价

blocks.en: One of two executors, Claude Opus 5.5 or GPT-6.1 Sol, implements each MVE in a new context. The same two executors serve all six models, so a smaller model’s proposals are not held back by its own implementation. The executor sees the seed paper, its code, and the one MVE it implements. We did not provide the other four MVEs, the ranking, the forecasts, or the name of the model that proposed the MVE. All MVEs of one model on a seed paper go to the same executor and the executors alternate across seed papers. Because both executors are among the six models, 58 of the 412 delivered MVEs were implemented by a separate instance of the model that proposed them. We run every MVE with the same limits, no matter its rank. The executor works on a separate machine with one A100 GPU for at most 45 minutes, may run open models of up to 8B parameters, and may not call hosted models. 3 3 3 On the seventh seed paper, 53 of its 60 MVEs were implemented and rerun on H200 machines with the same limits and prompts. If it refuses or exceeds its limits, the other executor makes one independent attempt. If both fail, the MVE is not delivered.
blocks.zh: 两个执行人中的一个 Claude Opus 5.5或GPT-6.1 Sol,在新的上下文中执行每个MVE. 同样的两个执行者服务于所有六个模式,因此一个较小模式的建议不会被自己的实施所阻碍. 执行者看到种子纸,它的代码,以及它执行的MVE. 我们没有提供其他四个MVE, 排名,预测,或者提出MVE的模型名称. 种子纸上一个型号的所有MVE都交给同一个执行人,执行人则在种子纸上交替. 由于这两个执行者都属于6个模式,412个交付的MVE中,有58个是由一个单独的模式实例提出的。 我们每辆MVE都有同样的限制 不管它的级别如何 执行器在一台单机上工作,一个A100 GPU最多45分钟,可能运行可达8B参数的开放模型,并且可能不会调用主机模型. 3 3 3 第7个种子纸上,其60个MVE中的53个被执行并重用限制和提示相同的H200机. 如果拒绝或超过其限度,另一个执行人会作出一次独立的尝试. 如果两者都失败了,MVE就无法交付.

blocks.en: We then delete the results that came with the executor’s submission and rerun its evaluation on a new machine the executor never used. The rerun determines whether the registered event occurred. An MVE is delivered when the rerun ends without error and writes a number. The rerun repeats the executor’s own code, so whether that code is right is left to the auditors.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们删除执行人提交的结果,并在执行人从未使用的新机器上重新进行评估。 重跑决定注册事件是否发生 。 MVE在重运行结束没有出错并写出数字时即会交付. 重播会重复执行者自己的代码, 所以该代码是否正确, 留给审计人员 。

blocks.en: Three auditors, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, and Grok 4.7, judge every delivered MVE. Grok 4.7 is not one of the six models we study and does not execute. The auditors see the registration, the executor’s notes, the output of the rerun, and the files it left. They do not see the seed paper or who proposed or implemented the MVE. Each auditor judges whether the MVE is faithful to its registration and valid and rates its research value from 0 to 3. We take the majority of the three judgments of faithfulness and validity and the median of the three research values. We call an MVE sound when it is faithful and valid, valuable when its research value is 2 or 3 and new when neither novelty judge found close prior work. The auditors also rank the five MVEs of each condition by research value. The MVE with the best mean rank is the auditors’ most valued MVE , against which we score the agent’s first choice.
blocks.zh: 三名审计员克洛德·奥普斯·5.5、GPT-6.1 Sol和Grok 4.7对每个交付的MVE进行评判。 Grok 4.7不是我们研究的六个模型之一,也不执行. 审计师们可以看到注册,执行者的笔记,重新运行的输出,以及它留下的文件. 他们没有看到种子纸,也没有看到谁提出或实施了MVE. 每个审计员都判断MVE是否忠实于其注册和有效,并评定其研究价值从0到3。 我们接受关于忠诚和有效性的三个判断中的大多数,以及三个研究价值的中位数。 我们称MVE声音是忠实而有效的,当其研究价值为2或3时很有价值,当没有一位新颖的法官发现前作很近时,我们称之为新声. 审计员还按研究价值对每个条件的五个最低收入水平进行排序。 MVE最差的级别是审计师最有价值的MVE,

blocks.en: After the study, we added a review of every delivered MVE. Three reviewers, the same models as the auditors, read the seed paper’s text, the registration, and what the auditors were shown, but none of the forecasts, rankings, audits, or novelty labels. They answered fixed questions: how the MVE relates to the seed paper, how obvious its idea is, and what the evidence says about the hypothesis.
blocks.zh: 研究结束后,我们增加了对每个交付的MVE的审查. 三名审核员,与审核员相同的模型,阅读了种子纸的文本,注册,以及审核员所显示的内容,但没有任何预测,排名,审计,或新颖的标签. 他们回答了固定的问题:MVE与种子纸的关系如何,它的理念有多明显,证据对假说有什么说法.

blocks.en: 4 Findings
blocks.zh: 4 调查结果

blocks.en: Of the 84 conditions, 83 produced MVEs. 4 4 4 On one seed paper, the provider of Claude Opus 5.5 refused the requests of its single researcher before the agent proposed anything. We make each comparison within seed papers and report its average over the seven seed papers, with a 95% confidence interval (CI) computed across them.
blocks.zh: 在这84个条件中,83个生产了MVE. 4 4 4 在一份种子纸上,克劳德·奥普斯5.5的提供商在代理商提出任何建议之前拒绝了其单一研究员的请求. 我们通过种子文件进行每次比较,并报告其平均比照7个种子文件,在它们之间计算出95%的置信间隔。

blocks.en: 4.1 Quality of the MVEs
blocks.zh: 4.1 MVE的质量

blocks.en: Table 1: Model comparison, single researcher (SR) and research team (RT). Sound, valuable and new: mean number of the five MVEs of a condition. Beyond the paper and non obvious, rated non obvious, and on a list of obvious follow ups: numbers of MVEs. Brackets: 95% CI over seed papers. † Its single researcher ran on six seed papers (30 MVEs); in the first column, RT minus SR counts the seventh as zero.
blocks.zh: 表1:模型比较,单人研究员(SR)和研究团队(RT). 声音,价值和新:一个条件的5个MVE的平均值. 除了论文和不明显的,被评为"非明显的",在一系列明显的后续:MVE的数量. 括号:95%的CI出自种子纸上。 其单人研究员跑取了6份种子论文(30 MVes);在第一栏中,RT减SR将第七分算为0.

blocks.en: We count an MVE as sound, valuable and new when it meets all three (Section 3.4 ). Nearly all MVEs were delivered and most were judged sound, so most of those that fall short repeat prior work or have low research value. Because the seed papers are recent, new mostly means not yet published: most MVEs on a list of obvious follow ups are also new. The four larger models propose about three such MVEs in five and the two smaller models about one. The gap holds for single researchers and for teams, while the order among the four larger models changes from one seed paper to another.
blocks.zh: 我们把 " MVE " 算作 " 健全、有价值和新的 " (第3.4节)。 几乎所有的MVE都交付了,大多数被评为声音,因此,大多数不足的MVE重复了先前的工作或者研究价值低. 由于种子论文是最近才出版的,所以新作大多表示尚未出版:在明显后续的列表中大多数MVE也是新作. 4个较大的模型提出了5个中的3个这样的MVE,2个较小的模型大约1个. 差距对单一研究人员和团队来说是存在的,而四个更大的模型的顺序则从一个种子纸变为另一个种子纸.

blocks.en: The smaller models’ MVEs often run as registered but leave the question open. For each sound MVE, the reviewers stated what the evidence says about the hypothesis, and we call the evidence informative when at least two of them read it as for, against, or mixed. MVEs of GPT-6 Luna are sound as often as those of GPT-6.1 Sol, but their evidence is informative about half as often (38% against 74%), and that of Muse Spark 1.3 is similar (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 小型型号的MVE经常作为注册型号运行,但对问题不作定论。 对于每个声音MVE,审查者都陈述了证据对假设的描述,当其中至少两人读到证据的内容是针对,反对,或者混合. GPT-6 Luna的MVES音效和GPT-6.1 Sol一样多,但是其证据的音效大约是一半(38%对74%),而Muse Spark1.3的音效类似(表一.

blocks.en: 4.2 Kinds of experiments
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 实验

blocks.en: The agent is asked to use the seed paper as inspiration for novel research and it chooses the question itself. To see which questions it chooses, we use the reviewers’ answers on how each MVE relates to the seed paper (Table 2 ) and the lists of obvious follow ups that each model wrote from the seed paper alone (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 代理商被要求将种子纸作为小说研究的灵感,它自己选择问题. 为了了解它所选择的问题,我们用审查员的答案来说明每个MVE如何与种子纸(表2)和每个模型单独从种子纸(第3.3节)中写明的明显后续行动清单。

blocks.en: Table 2: The kind of experiment each model proposes, SR / RT: counts of delivered MVEs by the answer that at least two of the three reviewers give.
blocks.zh: 表2:每个模型提议的实验类型,SR /RT:至少三位审查者中的两位给出的答案对交付的MVE进行计数.

blocks.en: Most MVEs build on the seed paper rather than check it, and few open a new direction. By the reviewers’ answers, 66% of the delivered MVEs build on the paper, 24% check one of its claims, and 5% open a direction that the paper merely suggests (Table 2 ). Building on the paper is often the obvious next step: 44% of all MVEs match an experiment on one of the lists of obvious follow ups. The agents also converge on the same experiments. On one seed paper ( Nguyen-Tri et al., 2026 ) , a method for faster decoding whose appendix gives a correctness argument, all eight conditions of the four larger models wrote the same check of that argument first.
blocks.zh: 大多数MVE基于种子纸而不是检查,很少打开一个新的方向. 根据审查者的回答,66%的交付的MVE基于论文,24%检查其索赔,5%打开了论文仅仅暗示的方向(表2)。 在论文的基础上发展往往是显而易见的下一步:44%的MVE与其中一份明显后续清单上的实验相匹配. 这些物剂也聚集在同一实验上. 在一份种子纸上(Nguyen-Tri等,2026年),一种较快解码的方法,其附录给出了正确性论证,四个较大模型的所有八个条件都先写了同样的论证.

blocks.en: Two models more often go beyond the paper with an experiment that is not obvious. We call an MVE non obvious when at least two reviewers say that few or none of ten researchers would list it and that the paper neither reports nor names it, and beyond the paper and non obvious when at least two reviewers each say this and also that it builds on the paper or opens a new direction. This rating comes from the reviewers and differs from the lists of obvious follow ups: a fifth of these MVEs are also on a list. GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol proposed two thirds of them (Table 1 ), and they lead for each reviewer separately. Within seed papers, their share of such MVEs exceeds that of Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5 by 48 percentage points (95% CI 29 to 66) and is higher on all seven seed papers. GPT-6 Luna, a smaller model from the same provider, builds on the paper as often, but the reviewers rate few of its ideas non obvious. MVEs beyond the paper and non obvious are sound, valuable and new at least as often as the others, but their registered events occur less often. Of the 194 sound, valuable and new MVEs, 73 are beyond the paper and non obvious. The reviewers recommend a larger study more often for the MVEs of Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5 than for those of GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol.
blocks.zh: 两种模型更常以不明显的实验来超越论文. 我们称MVE是不明显的,因为至少两名审查者说,十个研究者中很少有或没有一个会列出,而且论文既不报告也不点名,除了论文之外,至少两名审查者都这样说,而且论文还以论文为基础或开辟了新的方向。 这一评分来自审查者,与明显后续的列表不同:其中五分之一的MVE也在列表中. GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 导弹 索尔提出了三分之二的建议(表1),他们分别领导每个审查员。 在种子纸中,它们在这种MVE中的份额超过克洛德·菲克5.1和克洛德·奥普斯5.5的48个百分点(95%的CI 29至66分),在所有7个种子纸上都更高. GPT-6 Luna是同一供应商的一个更小的模型,它经常以论文为基础,但审查者认为其想法很少不明显。 纸外和不明显的MVE是健全、有价值和新颖的,至少与其他的一样频繁,但其登记的事件较少发生。 在194个声音,有价值和新的MVE中,有73个超过纸张,不明显. 与GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 Sol相比,审查人员建议对克洛德Fable 5.1和克洛德Opus 5.5的MVes进行更大的研究。

blocks.en: 4.3 Registered events and evidence
blocks.zh: 4.3 已登记的事件和证据

blocks.en: Each registration commits the agent to one registered event before the MVE runs and it is natural to read the event as the success of the experiment. For each sound MVE, we compare whether the event occurred with the reviewers’ reading of the evidence.
blocks.zh: 每次登记都要求代理人在MVE运行前参加一次已登记的活动,自然会将事件解读为实验的成功. 对于每个声音MVE,我们比较事件是否发生在审查者对证据的阅读.

blocks.en: Whether the event occurs depends on how the agent defines it. In most of their MVEs, GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol compare a bound of a confidence interval with the threshold, rather than a point estimate (Table 7 ), and the other four models rarely do. The events of GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol occur in 25% of their sound MVEs, compared with 52% for Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5 (Table 1 ). On one seed paper ( Liang et al., 2026 ) , four conditions tested whether a model’s own prediction errors harm decoding more than random errors of the same size, and all three reviewers read all four results as support for it. Three of the conditions had set the threshold at a difference of 5 percentage points and their events occurred. The fourth had set it at 8 points, and its event did not.
blocks.zh: 事件是否发生取决于代理人如何定义它. 在其大多数MVE中,GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 索尔将一个置信间隔的束缚与阈值进行比较,而不是一个点估计(表7),其他四个模型很少这样做. GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 Sol事件发生在其25%的音效MVE中,而克洛德Fable 5.1和克洛德·奥普斯 5.5的音效为52%(表1)。 在一份种子纸上(梁等,2026年),有四个条件检验了一个模型本身的预测错误是否比同样大小的随机错误更能解码出伤害,三个审查者都读了所有四个结果作为支持. 其中3个条件将阈值设定为5个百分点之差,并发生了这些事件。 第四个问题已经设定为8点,它的活动没有。

blocks.en: When the registered event does not occur, the evidence is often still informative. The reviewers judged the evidence informative for 50% of the sound MVEs whose event did not occur, mostly as evidence against the hypothesis. In the other direction, they judged the evidence inconclusive for 20% of the sound MVEs whose event occurred.
blocks.zh: 当登记的事件没有发生时,证据往往仍然资料丰富. 审查者对未发生事故的50%的有声音的MVE判断证据信息丰富,大多是作为反对假说的证据. 在另一个方向,他们判断,对于20%的发生事件的声音MVE来说,证据是没有结论的.

blocks.en: 4.4 Forecasts
blocks.zh: 4.4 预测

blocks.en: We next ask whether the agent that designed an MVE forecasts its registered event better than an outside reader. The outside reader is the same model judge, which sees only the seed paper and the five registrations. The agent’s own reading and search did not measurably improve its forecasts over this reader’s: the difference between their Brier scores (lower is better) is − - 0.006, with a 95% CI from − - 0.021 to 0.009 (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们接下来问设计MVE的代理商是否比外部读者更能预测其注册的事件. 外道读者为同名模型裁判,只见种子纸和五个注册. 代理商本身的阅读和搜索并没有比这名读者的预测大有改进:他们的Brier分数的差(较低)为--0.006,95%的CI从--0.021到0.009(表3).

blocks.en: Table 3: Brier scores by whose MVEs are forecast (rows) and who forecasts (columns), lower is better. Judges: A: GPT-6 Astra, F: Claude Fable 5.1, O: Claude Opus 5.5, S: GPT-6.1 Sol, L: GPT-6 Luna, M: Muse Spark 1.3. Underlined: the same model judge. Avg.: the Brier score of the mean of the six judges’ probabilities.
blocks.zh: 表3:布莱尔的分数由谁的MVE预测(rows)和谁预测(colums),分数更低. 法官:A:GPT-6 Astra,F:克洛德·寓言 5.1,O:克洛德·奥普斯 5.5,S:GPT-6.1 Sol,L:GPT-6 Luna,M:Muse Spark 1.3. 下划线:同名模特评委. Avg.:6名评委的概率平均值的布赖尔得分.

blocks.en: Both forecasts are more accurate than a base rate that gives every MVE the event rate of the other six seed papers (Brier score 0.240), and the mean of the six judges’ probabilities is more accurate than the agent (0.179 against 0.192). The agent has seen more than its registrations state, but it is not shown to know more about its events than its registrations tell a reader. The agents are also not uniformly overconfident: GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna and Muse Spark 1.3 state higher probabilities than the rates at which their events occur, while Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5 state lower ones.
blocks.zh: 这两种预测都比基准率更准确,基准率使每个MVE获得其他六份种子论文的事件率(Brier得分0.240分),六名裁判的概率平均值比代理人更准确(0.179比0.192分). 代理人的视线超过其注册状态,但并没有显示其对其事件的了解超过其注册告诉读者. 毒剂也并非一致地过度自信:GPT-6 Astra,GPT-6.1 Sol,GPT-6 Luna和Muse Spark 1.3的概率比出事率高,而克洛德·费布尔 5.1和克洛德·奥普斯 5.5的概率较低.

blocks.en: 4.5 First choices
blocks.zh: 4.5 第一个选择

blocks.en: The agent’s first choice is the auditors’ most valued MVE in 38% of conditions, where a random pick gives 20%. The MVE that the agent wrote first and the same model judge’s first choice are the most valued about as often, and we find no evidence that the agent’s first choice beats either: its advantage over the MVE written first is 3 percentage points (95% CI − - 8 to 15). The first choice is also sound, valuable and new no more often than a random pick.
blocks.zh: 代理商的首要选择是审计师在38%的条件下最有价值的MVE,其中随机抽取给出了20%. 代理商首先撰写的MVE以及同一位模特法官的第一选择, 也是最受重视的, 第一种选择也是声音,有价值和新颖的,只是随机选择.

blocks.en: Agents register their obvious experiments first: the MVE written first is on a list of obvious follow ups in 61% of conditions, against 35% for the fifth. The agents then rank largely in the order in which they wrote them, and their first choice is the MVE they wrote first in 47% of conditions, where 20% would be expected if order did not matter. The event of the first choice occurs in 47% of conditions and that of the last choice in 29%, so the first choice is often an experiment likely to come out as registered. The auditors also rank sound MVEs whose event occurred higher, mostly because these MVEs give clearer evidence.
blocks.zh: 代理人首先登记他们的明显实验:MVE首先写在61%条件下的明显后续清单上,而第五个是35%。 然后,特工们大致按照他们写作的顺序排列,他们的第一个选择是他们首先在47%的条件下写作的MVE,如果命令无关紧要的话,预计20%会写作. 首选事件发生在47%的条件下,而后选事件发生在29%的条件下,因此首选往往是可能以注册形式出现的实验. 审计人员还将事件发生的频率高的磁盘定级,主要是因为这些磁盘提供更明确的证据。

blocks.en: The judges rank in the same way: they too put the MVE written first on top in 39% of conditions on average. They and the auditors also rank obvious follow ups higher, and an agent’s ranking agrees more with the same model judge and with other judges from the same provider than with judges from other providers. On average, a judge’s first choice is an MVE beyond the paper and non obvious less often than a random pick would be, while the agent’s own first choice is one about as often.
blocks.zh: 法官的排名相同:他们也把MVE在平均39%的条件下列为第一名。 他们和审计员对后续行动的排名也明显较高,而代理人的排名更同意同一模式法官和同一提供者的其他法官,而不是其他提供者的法官。 平均而言,法官的第一选择是超过纸张的MVE,不明显的选择比随机选择要少,而代理商自己的第一选择是同样多的选择。

blocks.en: 4.6 Single researchers and teams
blocks.zh: 4.6 单一研究人员和团队

blocks.en: A team proposes more sound, valuable and new MVEs than a single researcher of the same model, 0.71 more of five on average, but the difference is not statistically significant (95% CI − - 0.10 to 1.52; Table 1 ). The difference is largest for the two smaller models, about one more of five, at about the cost of a single researcher. Claude Opus 5.5 working alone does as well as its team.
blocks.zh: 一个团队提出比同一模型的单个研究员更健全,更有价值和新的MVE,平均每5人多0.71人,但差别在统计学上并不显著(95% CI−-0.10到1.52;表1.). 对于两个更小的模型来说,差别最大,大约是另外五个模型中的一个,大约是一个研究者的成本. 克洛德·奥普斯·5.5 单独工作 和它的团队一样

blocks.en: A team changes little in what is proposed. Its MVEs check the paper, match the lists of obvious follow ups, and are beyond the paper and non obvious about as often as a single researcher’s. They are rated non obvious somewhat more often (Table 1 ), but the 95% CI includes zero. What the critic and the lead change is the design of each experiment: teams more often compare a confidence bound with the threshold and state lower probabilities.
blocks.zh: 团队在提议中几乎没有变化。 它的MVE检查了报纸,与明显的后续行动清单相匹配,并且超过了报纸的范围,而且不像一个研究者那样频繁。 它们被评为非明显(表1),但95%的CI包括零。 评论家和主角的改变是每个实验的设计: 团队更经常地将一个被束缚的置信度与阈值进行比较,并声明较低的概率.

blocks.en: 4.7 Execution and resources
blocks.zh: 4.7 执行和资源

blocks.en: Table 4: Execution tokens and compute by model, SR / RT.
blocks.zh: 表4: 执行令牌和按型号计算,SR / RT.

blocks.en: A condition cost $15.31 on average for a single researcher and $23.93 for a team, counting the agent’s model calls and the implementation and rerun of its five MVEs (Table 1 ). Per $100, single researchers produced 13 sound, valuable and new MVEs and teams 11, and GPT-6.1 Sol produced the most. The cost of proposing differs about a hundredfold between models, from GPT-6 Luna to Claude Fable 5.1, while the cost of implementing and rerunning an MVE differs about twofold, since the same two executors served every model. Without the requirement of novelty, a team of GPT-6 Luna produced as many sound and valuable MVEs per $100 as GPT-6.1 Sol, but about half as many beyond the paper and non obvious, where GPT-6.1 Sol produced the most.
blocks.zh: 单名研究人员的平均费用为15.31美元,团队的平均费用为23.93美元,计算了代理商的型号呼叫以及执行和重新运行其五个MVE的情况(表1)。 每100美元,单人研究人员生产出13个声音,有价值和新的MVE和11组,而GPT-6.1 Sol产量最多. 从GPT-6 Luna到Claude Fable 5.1, 提议的成本在模型之间大约相差了100倍,而执行和重运行MVE的成本则相差了一倍,因为同样的两个执行者服务于每个模型. 没有新颖性的要求,由GPT-6 Luna组成的团队每100美元生产出同GPT-6.1 Sol一样多的有声而有价值的MVE,但比纸张多出大约一半,且不明显,GPT-6.1 Sol产量最多.

blocks.en: The executors delivered 397 of the 415 MVEs on their first attempt, and the limits were rarely reached: the median implementation took 12 minutes, well within its limits (Appendix A.3 ). The agents reached their tool call limit in 5% of conditions. The MVEs of Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5 take more than twice as much GPU time to implement as those of GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol (Table 4 ). The auditors judge 18% of the MVEs implemented by the Claude Opus 5.5 executor not sound, compared with 3% of those implemented by the GPT-6.1 Sol executor, while the evidence is informative equally often under both.
blocks.zh: 执行者在第一次尝试时交付了415辆MVE中的397辆,并且很少达到限额:执行的中位数需要12分钟,远远在限额之内(附录A.3. 代理商在5%的条件下达到了工具呼叫限制. Claude Fiable 5.1和Claude Opus 5.5的MVES的执行时间是GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 Sol(表4)的两倍多。 审计师判断克劳德·奥普斯·5.5执行官实施的MVes有18%不健全,而GPT-6.1执行官实施的MVs有3%不健全,而证据在两者下往往同样具有信息性。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: We began this study to see how many good small experiments frontier models can propose when a recent paper is their source of inspiration. By a good MVE we mean one that is small and not obvious and that opens a direction worth a larger study. Most of the experiments were sound, but most either tested the seed paper itself or extended it in a way that many researchers would propose, and few opened a new direction. Current agents appear better suited to examining a paper and taking its obvious next steps than to moving beyond it. That is useful in itself, since a new paper’s claims can be checked under controls and stricter measurements for a few dollars each, but it is a different capability from proposing new research, and evaluations of research agents should measure the two separately.
blocks.zh: 我们开始这个研究是为了看看当最近一篇论文成为其灵感来源时,有多少好的小型实验前沿模型可以提出. 通过一个好的MVE,我们是指一个小而不明显的,并且开启一个值得更大研究的方向。 大部分实验都是有声的,但大多数或者测试了种子纸本身,或者以许多研究者会提出的方式扩展了它,很少有人打开了新的方向. 目前的代理人似乎更适合审查一份文件,并采取显而易见的下一步步骤,而不是超越该文件。 这本身是有用的,因为新文件的声称可以受到控制和更严格的衡量,每份几美元,但这与提议新的研究不同,对研究代理人的评价应该分别衡量两者。

blocks.en: The models differ less in how often their experiments are sound than in what kind of experiment they propose. GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol more often go beyond the paper with an experiment that is not obvious and register stricter tests, which pass less often. Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5 stay closer to the paper and register tests that pass more often. The experiments of the two smaller models more often leave the question open. Choosing a model is therefore also choosing a kind of experiment. Because the price of proposing differs far more between models than the cost of running an MVE, a small model working as a team with a capable executor yields about as many sound and valuable experiments per dollar as the most efficient large model, though fewer beyond the paper.
blocks.zh: 这些模型在它们的实验多长的频率上,与其提出的实验种类相比,差别较小. GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 导弹 更常见的是,用一个不明显的实验来超越论文,并记录更严格的测试,而测试通过得较少. Claude Fable 5.1和Claude Opus 5.5保持更接近于纸张并登记更经常通过的测试. 两个更小的模型的实验更经常地留下问题. 因此,选择一个模型也是选择一种实验. 因为提议价格在模型之间比运行MVE的成本大得多,一个小模型作为一个团队工作,一个有能力的执行者每美元能产生多少声音和价值的实验,与最有效的大型模型差不多,但比论文要少.

blocks.en: In our study every experiment ran with the same limits, so the agents’ rankings stated priorities and did not decide what would be implemented. Those rankings followed the order in which the agents wrote their MVEs and favored the ones likely to pass. A natural next study gives an agent a fixed research budget to allocate among its own MVEs and to revise after the first results, and asks whether the budget goes to the MVEs that turn out sound, valuable and non obvious. The same budget given to human researchers would show how their allocations compare and provide a human baseline. This would extend the evaluation from what an agent proposes and expects to how it spends a limited budget, the decision in which researchers exercise their taste.
blocks.zh: 在我们的研究中,每一个实验都有同样的限度,所以代理商的排名都说明了优先顺序,没有决定执行什么。 这些排名遵循了特工们撰写他们的MVE的顺序,并倾向于那些可能通过的人. 一项自然的下一个研究给予一个代理人一个固定的研究预算,在自己的MVE中分配,并在初出炉后进行修改,并询问预算是否流向那些结果健全,有价值和不明显的MVE. 给人类研究人员的同样预算将表明他们的拨款如何比较并提供人类基线。 这将扩大评价的范围,使其从代理人提议和预期的到如何使用有限的预算,即研究人员如何行使他们的口味的决定。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en: All labels in this study come from models, so we lack a human baseline. The auditors judged soundness and value after seeing the outcomes and two of the three are models we also evaluate and use as executors. Every MVE was attempted regardless of its rank, so the ranking did not decide what ran. An agent whose ranking decides what runs may rank with more reasoning. Each registration had to be complete enough for a separate executor, so part of the forecasting result may be built into the design. Each condition ran once, so we have no measure of how much a result would change on a second run.
blocks.zh: 本研究中的所有标签都来自模型,所以我们缺乏人类基线. 审计员在看到结果后判断了健全性和价值,其中两个也是我们作为执行者评价和使用的模型。 每个MVE都尝试了不管其级别如何,所以排名并不决定跑出什么. 其排名决定什么是运行的代理商可能以更多的推理排序. 每次登记必须足够完整,可以单独执行人,因此可以将部分预测结果纳入设计. 每个条件都存在过一次,所以我们无法衡量第二次比赛的结果会改变多少。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We studied whether research agents can evaluate and predict the outcomes of their own experiments before they are run. Given a recent NLP paper, six frontier models proposed small experiments, forecast whether the result of each would pass a threshold they set and ranked them. A separate executor attempted every proposed experiment.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了研究代理人是否能够在运行之前评估和预测自己实验的结果. 鉴于最近的一份NLP文件,6个前沿模型提出了小的实验,预测每个实验的结果是否会通过它们设定的阈值并进行排名. 一个单独的执行者尝试了每一个提议的实验.

blocks.en: We find that the agents propose experiments that are often sound, valuable and new. However, their own reading and search did not measurably improve their forecasts or rankings over those of the same model judge, which read only the seed paper and the registrations. The evaluation harness and the dataset are available at https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste .
blocks.zh: 我们发现这些毒剂提出实验,这些实验往往是健全的,有价值的和新的. 然而,他们自己的阅读和搜索并没有比只读出种子纸和注册的同名模特法官的预测或排名大有改进. 可在https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste查阅评价手段和数据集。

blocks.en: A.3 Implementation compute
blocks.zh: A.3 执行计算

blocks.en:
The agent was told the execution environment and its limits before it registered. Every attempt at an MVE had the
same limits. An executor worked on one machine with an A100 GPU, 12 CPU cores and 142 GB of
memory, and had no keys for hosted API models. Experiments could run open models of 8B parameters or
fewer. The machine ran for at most 45 minutes from the executor’s first command, the implementation had 90 minutes in all, and the rerun on a new machine had 35 minutes. The executor had 60 model calls. Spending limits and the 90 minutes of an implementation are checked between model calls. On the seventh seed paper,
53 of its 60 MVEs were implemented and rerun on H200 machines with the same limits. If an attempt delivers nothing, the other executor makes one independent
attempt. A failure of a machine is not an attempt and is repeated.

value on a scale from 0 to 3 (the prompt is in Appendix D ). The rule takes the majority of

blocks.en: We take the answer that at least two of the three reviewers give. For how the hypothesis relates to the paper (Table 2 ), the review prompt counts a test of a property or a side effect of the paper’s method that the paper makes no claim about as building on the paper. We call an MVE non obvious when at least two reviewers say that few or none of ten researchers would list it and that the paper neither reports nor names it; an answer of reported or named counts only when its copied passage is found in the paper. An MVE is beyond the paper and non obvious when at least two reviewers each say that it is non obvious and that it builds on the paper or opens a new direction. The evidence is informative when at least two reviewers read it as for, against, or mixed.
blocks.zh: 我们接受三个审查者中至少两个提出的答案。 关于该假设如何与文件相关(表2),审查迅速计算出对文件方法的地产或副作用的检验,即文件没有声称是纸上建材。 我们称MVE是非明显的,因为至少两名审查者说,10名研究人员中很少有或没有一位将它列入清单,而且论文既不报告也不命名;只有在论文中找到其复制的段落时,才能回答报告或被点名的问题。 当至少两名审查人员各自说它不是显而易见的,而且它建立在纸上或开辟了一个新的方向时,MVE就超出了纸面,也不明显。 如果至少有两名审查人员读到证据是针对、反对或混合的,则证据是翔实的。
